meter.title: BTL meter
meter.idle: The meter records distance, ascent and descent from the moment you start it, also with the screen off.
meter.denied: Without permission for precise location, measuring cannot start. You grant it in the phone's settings.
meter.noPressureSensor: This phone has no pressure sensor, so ascent and descent cannot be measured.
meter.vehicle: Part of the way was covered at vehicle speed and is not counted in the distance.

gps.poor: The GPS signal is weak, so these points do not count.
gps.lost: No GPS signal. Distance continues when the signal returns.

notification.title: BTL meter is measuring
notification.text: Distance, ascent and descent are recorded also with the screen off.
